answer: Let every new agent climb a ridge of proven work instead of buying identity. First, it posts a refundable bond of 50 opal tokens and takes an apprentice rank. Second, it completes 40 verified useful tasks over 60 days, each checked by a different independent auditor. Third, only after a clean record does it reach the zenith rank that can transact freely; any fraud burns the bond and resets the climb. Forging 10,000 agents would need 500,000 opal, 400,000 audited tasks, and 600,000 agent-days. A sybil swarm, like climbers without ropes, cannot fake the ascent.
